d3_2025_summer.method: zero solves. (1) The ADMM-prepared models of instance B under V-1 are rebuilt with the diagnostics launcher's initialisation round in its trial form (every optimize stubbed, sigma replaced by sigma_fixed; stopped at _build_pristine_snapshot_bases): the static boxes (TSO interface_delta +- rating, TSO ADN-bus V bounds and the fixed voltage slacks, DSO reference-generator pg / qg bounds, DSO reference-node V bounds) are build-time and do not depend on the solution. (2) The only solution-dependent quantity, the TSO ADN-load pc / qc (fixed once, at TSO model creation, at the DSO initial expectation; never changed in the distributed path), is set from the V1 instance-B smoke run's own value: its interface_settlement_detail_s31c.json interface_reporting_detail anchor_p_mw / anchor_q_mvar (production `_get_interface_reporting_detail`: pc x s_base, read on the terminal models) divided by s_base. (3) The diagnostics launcher's d3_boxes (by import) on complete inputs; a copy of it with a scenario filter for the 8 available singles

failure_policy: Failure of any prediction is recorded, never re-run or tuned. A harness fault (exception, guard mismatch, child exit != 0) is recorded and the order stops for the Planner; an initialisation-identity mismatch raised by the harness is such a stop (it is the S-P3 check). The step 4 main run, any cap above 3, concurrent or detached runs and undeclared solves are not permitted.
objective_convention: Q in EUR of total discounted cost. Coupled arms: primary gross_operational_cost = settlement excluded in full (pin excluded, salvage separate), contracted-excluded beside it. Pinned arms: gross_operational_cost = contracted settlement and pin excluded. C_central: step 3 gross EUR/day (settlement weight 0, no salvage); Q_block - w_b C_central in EUR of total discounted cost

predictions_operational.S-P2:
coupled arms (V1, V2), every cycle c = 1..3, all with rel = |a - b| / max(|a|, |b|, 1):
(i) T_c = sum over every agent block (TSO and each DSO) of w x settlement_total_unweighted from the S56 capture (production `_get_local_interface_settlement(part='total')` x `_get_admm_block_weight` -- the terms production's `_get_operational_interface_settlement_blocks` sums); rel(priced_residual_price_part_c, -T_c) <= 1e-9. At c = 3 also against the record's production `recourse_components.interface_settlement_total`.
(ii) D_c = sum over agent blocks of w x (settlement_total_unweighted - settlement_contracted_unweighted) (S56 capture); rel(gross_operational_cost_contracted_excluded_c - gross_operational_cost_c, D_c) <= 1e-9 (per_cycle_record fields). The production deviation part (`part='deviation'`) is not recorded per cycle for the TSO: the decomposition total - contracted == deviation is checked per cycle on the DSO blocks (rel(sum_DSO w(total - contracted), per_cycle_response covariance_dso_weighted) <= 1e-9) and at c = 3 on every block (rel(D_3, record interface_settlement_deviation_total) <= 1e-9 and rel(LHS_3, the same) <= 1e-9).
(iii) every deviation-dual coordinate (agent, kind, DN block, period) of interface_duals_per_cycle.jsonl (`lambda_dev_<kind>_<agent>`, scenario order = header deviation_channel.scenarios): |sum_s omega_s mu_s| <= 1e-9 x max|mu| (max over that cycle, agent and kind); omega_s = prob_market[s_m] x prob_operation[s_o] of the block (multiscenario_terminal per_scenario_costs probability of the TSO block).
(iv) V1 only: the record's terminal recourse_components.voltage_pin_total == 0.0 and voltage_pin_tso == 0.0 and every voltage_pin_dso value == 0.0 (production `_get_local_voltage_pin` returns 0.0 when `scenario_voltage_pin` is absent, which it is under 'per_scenario'); production records no per-cycle pin total, so cycles 1-2 are covered by the structural reading, not by a recorded value

recorded_only: per cycle and per block, Q_block - w_b x C_central in EUR of total discounted cost, for every block with a C_central; w_b = the instance's own block weight.
